item.text: [{"taxonId":981326,"summary":"A leafy moss found across Europe, Macaronesia, Turkey, the Caucasus, North Africa and North America, especially in Mediterranean and sub-Mediterranean regions. It mainly occupies still, nutrient-poor ponds and swamps, and has slender needle-like leaves held close to upright shoots.
